demo_route_mode_ck.name: demo_route_mode_ck
demo_route_mode_ck.value:
"demo_identity_route"."generation" > 0 and (("demo_identity_route"."mode" = 'demo' and "demo_identity_route"."session_id" is not null)
    or ("demo_identity_route"."mode" in ('commercial','blocked') and "demo_identity_route"."session_id" is null))

demo_session_kind_ck.name: demo_session_kind_ck
demo_session_kind_ck.value:
("demo_session"."kind" in ('internal','web') and "demo_session"."actor_user_id" is not null and "demo_session"."request_key" is not null and "demo_session"."authorization_id" is null and "demo_session"."conversation_id" is null
    and (("demo_session"."kind" = 'web' and "demo_session"."web_token_hash" is not null) or ("demo_session"."kind" = 'internal' and "demo_session"."web_token_hash" is null)))
    or ("demo_session"."kind" = 'external' and "demo_session"."authorization_id" is not null and "demo_session"."conversation_id" is not null and "demo_session"."web_token_hash" is null)

demo_wa_link_state_ck.name: demo_wa_link_state_ck
demo_wa_link_state_ck.value:
("demo_whatsapp_link"."external_session_id" is null and "demo_whatsapp_link"."thread_ref" is null and "demo_whatsapp_link"."linked_at" is null and "demo_whatsapp_link"."bsuid_lookup" is null)
    or ("demo_whatsapp_link"."external_session_id" is not null and "demo_whatsapp_link"."thread_ref" is not null and "demo_whatsapp_link"."linked_at" is not null)

dispatch_demo_scope_ck.name: dispatch_demo_scope_ck
dispatch_demo_scope_ck.value:
("dispatch"."scope_kind" = 'demo' and "dispatch"."demo_session_id" is not null and "dispatch"."route_generation" > 0)
      or ("dispatch"."scope_kind" in ('commercial') and "dispatch"."demo_session_id" is null)

lse_loss_reason_ck.name: lse_loss_reason_ck
lse_loss_reason_ck.value: "lead_stage_event"."to_stage_kind" <> 'lost' OR "lead_stage_event"."approximate" = true OR "lead_stage_event"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL

message_demo_scope_ck.name: message_demo_scope_ck
message_demo_scope_ck.value:
("message"."scope_kind" = 'demo' and "message"."demo_session_id" is not null and "message"."route_generation" > 0)
      or ("message"."scope_kind" in ('commercial','blocked') and "message"."demo_session_id" is null)
